label: Star Lane
summary: A glittering street of talent agencies where trainees spend years in practice rooms for one chance to debut.

world.setting: Star Lane, the talent agency district of a big, bright city
world.description: Every building on Star Lane is a talent agency, a dance studio or a coffee shop full of exhausted trainees. Agencies sign young adults to train for years, then pick a handful to debut as a group. Contracts are strict, rankings are posted every month, and the fans are already watching before anyone has a name.
rules: Every character is an adult; the youngest trainees are nineteen
Dating is against the contract, which makes everything more complicated
Rivals can become friends, and friends can become rivals

narration.tone: Glossy, heartfelt and a little dramatic
